description: VaultysID post-quantum identities and DHIES v3 cross-language vectors (rfc/PQ-ENCRYPTION.md §11), generated by the TypeScript reference, deterministic
notes: Seeds, entropy, ephemeral keys, ML-KEM randomness and nonces are pinned test values (SHA-512 of a label); never reuse them.
secret = type || MessagePack {v: 1, s: seed} (Dilithium) or {v: 1, alg: 'hybrid', s: seed} (Hybrid).
dhiesV3[].key is k of §5.2; es, ss, kss and info are intermediate values given for debugging.
kemRandomness is the 32-byte m of FIPS 203 ML-KEM.Encaps_internal.
